{
  "source_id": "S03497b210d84149c",
  "study_or_document_type": "randomized controlled study",
  "population_and_intervention": "Elderly subjects with increased pulse pressure (PP ≥60 mmHg) assigned to yoga or brisk-walking with stretching (1h morning, 6 days/week for 12 weeks)",
  "measured_outcome_or_recommendation": "Arterial stiffness measures (baPWV, c-f PWV, AIx@75, aASI) and endothelial function (NOx) improved significantly in stretching group",
  "finding": "Significant reductions in arterial stiffness (c-f PWV: 1.25 m/s, p<0.001; baPWV: 1.96 m/s, p<0.01) and improved endothelial function (NOx: -9.03 μmol/L, p<0.001) in stretching group",
  "relation": "contradiction",
  "limitations": [
    "Intervention was stretching with brisk walking, not isolated stretching",
    "Only elderly with increased pulse pressure (PP ≥60 mmHg)",
    "Results measured after 12 weeks of intervention, not immediate effects",
    "No comparison to control group without stretching"
  ],
  "quotes": [
    "The mean between-group change (with 95% CI) in arterial stiffness: c-f PWV(m/s) [1.25(0.59-1.89); p<0.001]",
    "endothelial function index: NO(μmol/L) [-9.03(-14.57 to -3.47), p<0.001]"
  ]
}
